title: grid: reflow: Preserve cells with background color
body:
A cell was previously considered empty if its content is empty.
When an empty cell has a non-default background color, truncating such
cells from the end of the line when reflowing is unexpected. Instead,
treat such cells as non-empty to preserve them.

Fixes #2462

Signed-off-by: Celina Sophie Kalus <hello@celinakalus.de>
